Name: Brighter Hair Selector
Author: brokenmirror1
Description:
Brightens the vanilla hair styles so that color is more vibrant and visible. Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿. You can use the mod config menu to select which level of brightness. I've tried to retain some of the darker edges and outlines in the brighter images, as well as the detail in the hair, that you naturally lose when brightening/darkening an image.

Changing the config in-game may require a restart. I can't really do anything about this, I don't know how to make Content Patcher reload the files immediately after changing the config. If you don't want to restart, after you save the config you can type this into the SMAPI console.
[code]patch reload "Zyro.HairSelector"
[/code]

Manifest.Name: Brighter Hair Selector
Manifest.Description: Does what it says on the box.
